issues.quote: Casimir and I played piquet in the salon. We have played together a great many times, and he is the oldest friend in this house.
issues.fact: O2 says the piquet partner is "the doctor."
issues.misreading: The transcript never says Casimir is the doctor. Only the closing line, "The doctor will want to go home," mentions a doctor, so a solver could doubt that the man who left for cigars is the doctor.

issues.quote: I was thinking that Casimir would want his cigar and would be cross that it had gone out.
issues.fact: The fact sheet gives no information about how long Casimir was away or about any cigar being lit.
issues.misreading: The idea of a cigar going out implies a lit cigar and a long enough absence for it to extinguish, which hints at a duration the sheet does not give.

issues.quote: He is never without them between hands.
issues.fact: O2 says they played on without a break until he went out to fetch his cigars.
issues.misreading: "Between hands" suggests the game had natural pauses, so a solver could infer that a hand break occurred when he left, which the sheet does not support.
